purpose: Test one distinct MAE boosting family against the validated LightGBM SVD32 champion and the fixed 25% Hybrid Ridge blend.
source_scope: Official Regression Train only, cycles 47-79. No Test feature/label reads, external datasets, pretrained weights, Kaggle feedback, or group labels.
representation: R1-D expanded structured allowlist plus signal_stream TF-IDF word 1-2 (min_df=2, max_features=20000, sublinear_tf) and randomized TruncatedSVD32 (n_iter=7, seed=42); preprocessing, TF-IDF, and SVD are fit on each temporal fit partition only. Categorical structured columns are passed to CatBoost as native categories.
pilot_gate: Continue to the remaining four frozen primary fit cutoffs only if CatBoost mean clipped-MAE delta versus the frozen ridge_25 blend is <= +0.50 across the four pilot views and no single view is > +1.00. Otherwise retire the family after the two pilot fits.
post_full_six_blend_gate: Only after all six windows, measure paired residual correlation and row-level win rates against LGB. Evaluate one fixed 25% CatBoost / 75% LGB blend only if signed-error correlation <=0.93 and CatBoost has lower absolute error on >=40% of paired primary rows. No weight tuning.
reports: paired residual correlation and win rates
